name.description: Name of the level. At most 14 characters (Level Select buttons are sized for that).

tier.description: The level's tier: Level Select shows one row per tier. Tier 0 is unlocked from the start; each further tier unlocks when every level of the tier before it has been beaten. Tiers must run from 0 with no gaps.

duration.description: Length of the level measured in bars.

signature.description: Beat count per bar (e.g., 4 for common time).

vfx.description: Visual-effects timeline entries. If empty, the default vfx will be used.

time.description: Bar offset at which the effect triggers.

travelTime.description: Beats required for an atom to travel from the atom emitter to the containment ring.

barsInterval.description: Spawn interval in bars: an atom can only appear once every X bars, at a random moment inside each interval.

angle.description: Arc length (width) of the paddle, measured in degrees. Suggested starting value: 30.

duration.description: Duration of the paddle action measured in seconds, counted from the moment the paddle is set (pointer released). Suggested starting value: 3.

lives.description: Number of lives the player starts the level with.

additionalGameMechanics.description: Names of the additional game mechanics active in this level, fixed for the whole level. Required; if empty, the level only uses the core mechanic. Valid names: "atom capture", "supercharged atom" and "charged atom hold".

tip.description: Optional gameplay tip shown, one array item per line, with a READY button before the level starts. If missing, the level starts straight away.
